routes.purpose: Authenticate a user and preserve the requested next route.

related_api_endpoints.use: Fetch the signed-in user after token storage

prerequisites: User account exists
Backend auth API is reachable
routes.success_state: Tokens and user profile are stored, then the user is navigated to next or /.

routes.purpose: Create a user account and attempt automatic login.
main_user_actions: Enter full name, email, and password

related_api_endpoints.use: Fetch user profile after automatic login

prerequisites: Valid email address
Password has at least 8 characters
routes.success_state: Account is created. If automatic login succeeds, the user lands on /; otherwise the user is sent to /login.

routes.purpose: Show platform-wide counts, recent activity, and quick actions.
prerequisites: Valid access token
routes.success_state: Metrics, recent activity, and quick actions are rendered; empty state appears when no projects or repositories exist.
common_failure_states: Token refresh fails and redirects to /login

routes.purpose: List projects available to the current user and create new projects.
prerequisites: Valid access token
routes.success_state: Project cards render, or a new project is created and the user is navigated to /projects/:projectId.

routes.purpose: Show project metadata, repositories, members, and deployment status summary.
prerequisites: Current user can access the project
routes.success_state: Project overview, members, repository summary, and deployment summary are visible.
common_failure_states: Refresh rejected until CD PR is created and merged

routes.purpose: Edit project metadata and add project members.
main_user_actions: Add member by email and role
prerequisites: Current user can access the project
Backend authorizes metadata/member changes
routes.success_state: Project metadata updates or a member is added and the project query is refreshed.
common_failure_states: Member add fails or role is not allowed
Limitation existante : le formulaire de modification vise un PATCH absent du contrat API livré.

routes.purpose: List repositories imported into a project and provide the GitHub import entry point.
main_user_actions: Go to GitHub installations to import another repository
prerequisites: Current user can access the project
routes.success_state: Repository rows render, or the empty state links to GitHub installations.

routes.purpose: Manage write-only project secrets by environment.
prerequisites: Current user can access the project
Secret key uses uppercase letters, digits, and underscores
routes.success_state: Secret metadata appears in the selected environment; values are never read back.

routes.purpose: Start the GitHub App installation flow and show linked installations.

related_api_endpoints.use: Retrieve external GitHub App install URL

prerequisites: Valid access token
Backend has GitHub App configuration
routes.success_state: The browser is redirected to GitHub for installation, or linked installations are listed.

routes.purpose: Browse GitHub App installations and import accessible repositories into projects.
prerequisites: At least one GitHub installation
At least one project before importing
routes.success_state: Repository is imported and the user is navigated to /repositories/:repositoryId.

routes.purpose: Handle GitHub App installation callback query parameters and redirect to the next UI page.
prerequisites: GitHub redirects back with installation_id or error
routes.success_state: Success toast is shown, GitHub installation query is invalidated, and the user is redirected to /github/installations.

routes.purpose: Show repository metadata, latest analysis, CI pipelines, and next-step actions.
prerequisites: Repository was imported
Current user can access repository project
routes.success_state: Repository overview, analysis summary, CI history, and next steps render.

routes.purpose: Run asynchronous repository analysis and display the latest successful result.
main_user_actions: Review detected stack, tests, files, and recommendations
prerequisites: Repository was imported
Default branch is readable by backend/GitHub integration
routes.success_state: Analysis job succeeds, repository and latest analysis queries refresh, and latest analysis panels show stack/test details.

routes.purpose: Read saved CI workflows, including MCP previews, and access human-reviewed PR publication.

related_api_endpoints.use: Load project secrets for mapping and missing secret checks
Load detected env vars and suggested mappings
Read saved CI YAML and publication metadata
Read pipeline actions with pipeline_id and pagination

prerequisites: Latest repository analysis exists
Repository is imported from GitHub
Required project secrets are configured or intentionally deferred
routes.success_state: Saved YAML survives reload; reviewed projects open the exact action review before publication. PR references appear only after publication.

routes.purpose: Generate Kubernetes manifests and a GitHub Actions CD workflow, approve them, open a PR, and refresh deployment status.

related_api_endpoints.use: Load cloud targets, env vars, and required cloud secrets

prerequisites: At least one cloud target exists
Repository is imported
CD secrets are configured globally or in project secrets
Generated CD PR must be merged before deployment refresh can become live
routes.success_state: Generated files render in tabs, CD pipeline can be approved, PR URL appears, and deployment panel reports pending/deployed/failed status.

routes.purpose: Configure shared container registry and global cloud nodes for CI/CD.

related_api_endpoints.use: Create or update shared GHCR registry
Create or update global cloud node

prerequisites: Signed-in user has role admin
GHCR PAT for registry save
Azure credentials or kubeconfig strategy for cloud node save
routes.success_state: Registry or cloud node is saved, relevant queries refresh, and stored secret keys are shown for cloud nodes.
common_failure_states: Non-admin user sees admin access required
Registry token missing on first save
Encrypted secret values are not displayed after save

routes.purpose: Legacy admin cloud target route that redirects to /admin/infrastructure.
prerequisites: Valid access token
routes.success_state: User is redirected to /admin/infrastructure.
common_failure_states: Unauthenticated user is redirected to /login before redirect target renders

routes.purpose: Inspect a background job status, payload, result, and worker timeline.

related_api_endpoints.use: Load and poll job while queued or running

prerequisites: Known job id from an async frontend action such as repository analysis
routes.success_state: Job details render and polling stops when the job is succeeded or failed.

routes.purpose: Display recent platform audit events.

related_api_endpoints.use: List audit events, optionally supports project_id and repository_id params in service

prerequisites: Valid access token
Audit backend endpoint enabled for full event list
routes.success_state: Events render newest first; empty state appears when no events exist.
common_failure_states: Audit endpoint returns 404 or 501 and page shows not available

routes.purpose: Show a 404 page for unknown protected routes.
prerequisites: Unknown route inside protected AppLayout
routes.success_state: User sees 404 copy and can return to /.
common_failure_states: Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login before seeing protected 404

routes.purpose: Dedicated health view.
routes.success_state: Not implemented in current frontend.
common_failure_states: No /health route is declared in src/routes/router.tsx

routes.purpose: Consentir une connexion MCP pour des scopes et projets explicites.
prerequisites: Compte CNP authentifié ; permissions serveur actuelles
routes.success_state: Réponse API autorisée

routes.purpose: Consulter et révoquer ses connexions MCP.
prerequisites: Compte CNP authentifié ; permissions serveur actuelles
routes.success_state: Réponse API autorisée

routes.purpose: Retrouver les actions en attente de review.
prerequisites: Compte CNP authentifié ; permissions serveur actuelles
routes.success_state: Réponse API autorisée

routes.purpose: Examiner le snapshot immuable et accepter, refuser ou annuler.
prerequisites: Compte CNP authentifié ; permissions serveur actuelles
routes.success_state: Réponse API autorisée

routes.purpose: Suivre le parcours et ses blocages, sans sauter de review.
prerequisites: Compte CNP authentifié ; permissions serveur actuelles
routes.success_state: Réponse API autorisée

help_map.label: Submit login
help_map.description: Submits email and password, stores returned tokens, fetches /auth/me, and navigates to next or /.
required_state: Email and password fields are filled
help_map.expected_result: The user is authenticated and redirected to the requested page or dashboard.
troubleshooting_hints: Check email/password validation
Verify backend auth API is reachable
A 401 from protected APIs clears auth and redirects to /login

help_map.label: Create account
help_map.description: Creates an account and attempts automatic login.
help_map.expected_result: Account is created; user lands on dashboard if automatic login succeeds.
troubleshooting_hints: Duplicate email or invalid password will be rejected by backend
If auto-login fails, sign in manually from /login

help_map.label: Connect GitHub
help_map.description: Fetches the GitHub App install URL and redirects the browser to GitHub.
help_map.expected_result: Browser navigates to GitHub App installation flow.
troubleshooting_hints: If no install_url is returned, check backend GitHub app settings
If the user cancels installation, return to /github and retry

help_map.label: Create project
help_map.description: Creates a project from name, slug, and optional description.
required_state: Slug is lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens
help_map.expected_result: Project is created and the user is navigated to /projects/:projectId.
troubleshooting_hints: Use a unique slug
Fix frontend slug validation before submit
Check project creation permissions in backend

help_map.label: Add project member
help_map.description: Adds a member by email with owner, maintainer, or viewer role.
help_map.expected_result: Member is added and the project query refreshes.
troubleshooting_hints: Backend may reject unknown users or insufficient permissions
Confirm email spelling and selected role

help_map.label: Import repository
help_map.description: Imports the selected GitHub repository into the selected project.
help_map.expected_result: Repository is imported and the user is navigated to /repositories/:repositoryId.
troubleshooting_hints: Create a project before importing
Refresh installations if repositories are missing
Backend may reject duplicate imports

help_map.label: Run repository analysis
help_map.description: Queues async analysis for the repository default branch and polls the resulting job.
help_map.expected_result: Analysis job succeeds and latest analysis data refreshes.
troubleshooting_hints: If job fails, inspect /jobs/:jobId
Confirm GitHub installation can read the repository
Retry after transient worker errors

help_map.label: View CI requirements
help_map.description: Shows detected environment variables, suggested secret mappings, and missing project secrets before CI generation.
help_map.expected_result: Environment secret mapping panel appears when requirements contain detected env vars.
troubleshooting_hints: Run repository analysis first
Add missing project secrets from the CI secrets link
Shared GHCR registry covers GHCR_TOKEN when configured

help_map.label: Generate CI preview
help_map.description: Generates a GitHub Actions workflow preview using selected Docker, registry, AI explanation, and secret mapping options.
required_state: Secret mappings are valid if present
help_map.expected_result: Generated YAML and explanation render, status changes to generated.
troubleshooting_hints: If disabled, run analysis first
Check registry field and secret mappings
Review missing secret warnings before PR creation

help_map.label: Approve CI workflow
help_map.description: Approves the generated or adapted CI workflow before PR creation.
help_map.expected_result: Workflow status changes to approved and the Open Pull Request action becomes available.
troubleshooting_hints: Generate a preview first
If adapted YAML should be used, adapt before approving
Regenerating preview resets approval

help_map.label: Create CI Pull Request
help_map.description: Pushes a branch with the CI workflow and opens a Pull Request.
help_map.expected_result: Pull Request URL, number, and branch are displayed.
troubleshooting_hints: Resolve branch naming conflicts
Check GitHub app repository write permissions
Sync required secrets if selected

help_map.label: Save project secret
help_map.description: Creates a write-only project secret for the selected environment.
required_state: Key is uppercase letters, digits, and underscores
help_map.expected_result: Secret metadata appears in the environment list; the value is not shown again.
troubleshooting_hints: Use GHCR_TOKEN for registry auth when no shared registry exists
Secret values cannot be recovered from UI
Delete and recreate to rotate a value

help_map.label: Save registry
help_map.description: Creates or updates the shared GHCR registry and encrypted auth token.
required_state: Token is filled for first-time configuration
help_map.expected_result: Registry card shows configured/default state and token stored encrypted.
troubleshooting_hints: Non-admin users see access denied
Leave token blank only when updating an existing registry
Check registry namespace and PAT scopes

help_map.label: Save cloud node
help_map.description: Registers or updates a global Azure AKS cloud node and encrypted secret values.
required_state: Azure credentials or kubeconfig strategy values are provided
help_map.expected_result: Cloud node is listed and stored secret keys are shown.
troubleshooting_hints: Use Parse JSON to auto-fill from cnp_cd_contract
Backend 422 details are displayed in the validation panel
Secret values are not displayed after save

help_map.label: View CD requirements
help_map.description: Shows cloud targets, required cloud secrets, default image, and detected app env vars for CD generation.
required_state: At least one cloud node exists for preview generation
help_map.expected_result: Deployment options and required secret panels render.
troubleshooting_hints: Ask an admin to configure a cloud node when empty
Add missing app secrets in project secrets
Shared registry covers GHCR_TOKEN when configured

help_map.label: Generate CD preview
help_map.description: Generates Kubernetes manifests and a GitHub Actions CD workflow preview.
required_state: App name, image, image tag, port, and replicas are valid
help_map.expected_result: Generated file tabs, summary, and required secrets render.
troubleshooting_hints: If disabled, fill cloud target, app name, image, and tag
Resolve missing project secrets before relying on the generated workflow

help_map.label: Approve CD pipeline
help_map.description: Approves the generated CD preview before PR creation.
help_map.expected_result: CD status changes to approved and the Open Pull Request action becomes available.
troubleshooting_hints: Generate a preview first
Regenerating preview resets approval

help_map.label: Create CD Pull Request
help_map.description: Pushes a branch with generated CD workflow/manifests and opens a Pull Request.
required_state: GitHub installation can write to repository
help_map.expected_result: Pull Request URL, branch, and synced secrets are displayed.
troubleshooting_hints: Check branch naming conflicts
Ensure secrets can be synced to GitHub Actions
Deployment starts only after the PR is merged to main

help_map.label: Refresh deployment status
help_map.description: Refreshes live deployment status for a CD pipeline from the configured cluster.
required_state: A CD pipeline with status pr_created exists
CD PR has been created and usually merged
help_map.expected_result: Deployment panel updates to pending, deployed, failed, unknown, or not_deployed.
troubleshooting_hints: A 409 means create and merge the CD PR before refreshing
Pending often means waiting for a LoadBalancer IP
Failed deployments show details in the panel
